_comment: Stage A broad-screening candidate pool: a best-effort S&P 500 constituent list (Yahoo ticker convention, e.g. BRK-B not BRK.B), hand-compiled -- same disclaimer as config/universe.json: spot-check before relying on any single ticker, and expect some drift from the real-time index as reconstitutions happen (this needs an occasional manual refresh, not a live feed -- see docs/agentic-architecture-proposal.md section 8). This is NOT config/universe.json: tickers here are candidates for src/screening/run.ts's cheap Stage A screen, not automatically scored or ranked. A ticker only joins the live, fully-tracked universe (config/universe.json's effective set, via the promoted_tickers D1 table -- see migrations/0010_broad_screening.sql) if Stage A's screen_score puts it in the shortlist. US-only for this first build; S&P 400 MidCap and OMX Stockholm were deliberately deferred to keep the first version bounded and verifiable.
